summary: Backend-only re-test of the PHP backend (PHP 8.2 + SQLite harness at localhost:8888) after iteration-10 fixes. Ran the full previous suite (test_php_string_ids.py: 37 passed, 1 env-skip) plus a new 22-case suite (test_php_iteration11.py) targeting all 6 requested items. Combined: 59 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed (98% incl. skip / 100% of executed). ALL 4 iteration-10 defects are CONFIRMED FIXED: (1) full-object PUT now persists device_brand/device_model/serial_no/complaint/notes/service_fee/deposit/technician_id AND status together; (2) completed_at/picked_up_at are no longer re-stamped on repeated same-status PUTs (COALESCE works, verified with 2s gaps); (3) reply.php POST works for admin (200 + persisted admin_reply/admin_reply_by/admin_reply_at), 403 for technician, 401 unauth; (4) reply.php DELETE returns 200 for admin, 403 for non-admin, clears fields; (5) global exception handler on dashboard/stats.php returns exactly {"error":"Internal server error"} with HTTP 500 and NO file path / stack trace / SQLSTATE leak. Two remaining backend defects found: destructive partial PUT on repairs, and non-admin self password change blocked by admin-only users PUT.

minor.issue: DESTRUCTIVE PARTIAL UPDATE (HIGH). The hasFields branch always writes ALL 8 columns using `$b['x'] ?? ''` defaults, so a partial payload wipes the omitted columns. Reproduced: create repair (iPhone/X/SN1/orig/notes n1/fee 50000/deposit 10000) then PUT {"notes":"only notes changed"} -> 200, and GET returns device_brand='', device_model='', serial_no='', complaint='', service_fee=0, deposit=0. Safe only while phpMirror sends the whole object; any other caller (curl, future partial-save UI, retry with trimmed payload) silently destroys data. FIX: build the SET clause only from keys present in the body (or use COALESCE with NULL binds).

SELF PASSWORD CHANGE STILL NOT MIRRORED FOR NON-ADMINS (HIGH). store.js:192 now calls phpMirror.user.upsert() (fix confirmed in code), but users/index.php PUT is guarded by require_role(['admin']). Verified: technician 'qa_pw' PUT on its own record -> 403 {'error':'Forbidden - insufficient role'}, and login with the new password afterwards -> 401. So a technician/cashier changing their own password updates localStorage only and can never log in via MySQL/PHP mode. FIX: allow PUT when $user['id'] === $id (password-only fields), or add a dedicated /api/auth/change-password.php endpoint and call that from changeOwnPassword.
Role/full_name silently downgraded on partial payloads: role defaults to 'cashier' and full_name to '' when omitted. Same non-merging pattern as the repairs PUT.

ENV-ONLY: MySQL-only DATE_FORMAT/DATE_SUB/CURDATE cannot run on the SQLite harness, so it 500s here (now with a clean generic JSON error). Its business output remains UNVERIFIED — must be checked on the VPS MySQL.
ENV-ONLY skip: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE is unsupported by SQLite (1 skipped test). Correct for MySQL production but not exercised here.

action_items: Make PUT /api/repairs/index.php non-destructive: only update columns actually present in the JSON body (partial PUT currently blanks device_brand/model/serial_no/complaint and zeroes service_fee/deposit).

Allow non-admin users to change their OWN password through PHP (self-PUT on users or a dedicated change-password endpoint); currently 403 so the new phpMirror.user.upsert() call in store.js:192 is a no-op for technician/cashier.
Apply the same key-present merge logic to PUT /api/users (role silently becomes 'cashier', full_name '' when omitted).
Verify /api/dashboard/stats.php and repairs/parts.php on the real VPS MySQL — both are untestable on the SQLite harness.
critical_code_review_comments: repairs/index.php PUT: replace the fixed 8-column UPDATE with a dynamically built SET list from array_key_exists() keys; the current `?? ''` defaults are a data-loss hazard.
COALESCE(completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) is portable and works on both SQLite and MySQL — verified; no shim change was needed.
response.php set_exception_handler + register_shutdown_function correctly suppress leaks; consider also logging the request URI for easier VPS debugging.
reply.php: the require_role(['admin']) return value is used for admin_reply_by — good; NOW() is translated by the test shim only, which is fine for MySQL prod.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral SQLite harness /tmp/klinikkana_test.sqlite (recreated per run). Test rows r_qa_i11_*, u_qa_i11_tech, u_pwtest all deleted after use.
test_credentials: PHP API admin/admin123 (also technician qa_i11_tech/QaPass!23 created+deleted by tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bootstrap: pkill -f 'php -S 0.0.0.0:8888'; rm -f /tmp/klinikkana_test.sqlite; cd /app/php-backend && nohup php -S 0.0.0.0:8888 -t /app/php-backend >/tmp/php_server.log 2>&1 &  then: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_php_string_ids.py tests/test_php_iteration11.py -p no:randomly -q. Both files are green as of iteration 11. Remaining open items are the destructive partial repairs PUT and non-admin self password change (403). Frontend not retested this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration-10 defects: (a) PUT branched on isset($b['status']) making status and field updates mutually exclusive — fixed by the hasFields check that runs both UPDATEs; (b) reply.php called undefined require_auth() causing a PHP fatal — fixed with require_role(['admin']). Newly found: the field UPDATE statement writes a fixed column list with '' / 0 fallbacks, so any payload missing a key erases that column; and users PUT is admin-only, so the newly added phpMirror mirror call in changeOwnPassword is rejected with 403 for non-admin roles.
